UpdateStageDescription: Records licence acceptance so the official updater can run unattended
Running the official Urban Terror updater (about 1.5 GB on first install)
UpdateSourceArgs: -c "cd '{{$FullBaseDir}}' && echo 'Checking for Urban Terror updates...' &&bash UrTUpdater-Ded.sh -q && chmod +x Quake3-UrT-Ded.x86_64 && if [ ! -f q3ut4/server.cfg ]; then sed '/^map /d' q3ut4/server_example.cfg > q3ut4/server.cfg && echo 'set bot_enable 1' >> q3ut4/server.cfg && echo 'set bot_minplayers 0' >> q3ut4/server.cfg; fi && if [ ! -f q3ut4/mapcycle.txt ]; then cp q3ut4/mapcycle_example.txt q3ut4/mapcycle.txt; fi && echo 'Urban Terror is up to date'"
